name: Cutting Edge Technology speeds and strengthens Nanobot Reconstruction (#689)
contract: #689: Cutting Edge Technology 707398 is a native ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (aura 108) passive with two effects, both on EffectSpellClassMask (1048576,0,0) = family-34 flag bit 20: EffectMiscValue 22 SPELLMOD_DOT with BasePoints 19 DieSides 1 (+20%) and EffectMiscValue 19 SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME with BasePoints -21 DieSides 1 (-20%). Nanobot Reconstruction rank 13 is 502563: SpellFamilyName 34, SpellFamilyFlags (1048576,0,0), effect 0 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_HEAL with Amplitude 1000 and DurationIndex 3 (SpellDuration.dbc row 3 = 60000 ms). Unit::SpellHealingBonusDone selects SPELLMOD_DOT when damagetype is DOT, and AuraEffect::CalculatePeriodic applies SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME to the tick period at aura application, so the period becomes 800 ms and each tick heals 20% more. Its AttributesEx3 268435456 is SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_AND_TARGET_RESTRICTIONS, not SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS, so the IsAffectedBySpellMods gate does not reject these modifiers. The talent has no SPELLMOD_DURATION effect, so the 60 sec duration must stay unchanged.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Nanobot's periodic healing is unmodified without the talent
Cutting Edge Technology raises Nanobot's periodic healing by 20%
Nanobot's tick period is unmodified without the talent
Cutting Edge Technology shortens Nanobot's tick period by 20%
Apply Nanobot Reconstruction with the unmodified Tinker as its caster
Apply Nanobot Reconstruction with Cutting Edge Technology as its caster
The unmodified Nanobot aura ticks every second
Cutting Edge Technology makes the applied aura tick every 800 ms
The unmodified Nanobot aura lasts 60 sec
Cutting Edge Technology leaves the 60 sec duration alone
